entry.summary: The Department of Internal Affairs and NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi co-hosted the 12th International Interoperability Test Event for Digital Standards. The event brought together public and private sector digital leaders from New Zealand and around the world to test how digital credential systems work together.
